# Timer:startCondition

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the start condition of the timer.

```lua
local condition = timer:startCondition([condition])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `condition` | [Source](../../objects/Source/index.md) | optional |  |

## Returns

condition ([Source](../../objects/Source/index.md))

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:startCondition(CATEGORY_ALWAYS_ON)
```
